Target IaC language: Ansible playbook (YAML)

Task: Write an Ansible playbook deploying a Java application as a systemd service: installs OpenJDK 21, creates a service user, copies the application JAR, writes the systemd unit file, and starts the service. Idempotent across re-runs.

Output only the Ansible playbook (YAML) code, no commentary or markdown fences.
raw_response:
- name: Deploy Java application as a systemd service
  hosts: all
  become: true
  vars:
    app_name: myapp
    service_name: "{{ app_name }}"
    app_user: "{{ app_name }}"
    app_group: "{{ app_user }}"
    app_base_dir: "/opt/{{ app_name }}"
    data_dir: "/var/lib/{{ app_name }}"
    log_dir: "/var/log/{{ app_name }}"
    config_dir: "/etc/{{ app_name }}"
    runtime_dir: "{{ app_name }}"
    jar_name: "{{ app_name }}.jar"
    jar_src: "files/{{ jar_name }}"
    java_opts: "-Xms256m -Xmx512m -XX:+UseG1GC -XX:+ExitOnOutOfMemoryError"
    app_opts: ""
  pre_tasks:
    - name: Determine nologin shell path
      set_fact:
        nologin_shell_path: "{{ '/usr/sbin/nologin' if ansible_os_family == 'Debian' else '/sbin/nologin' }}"

    - name: Determine OpenJDK 21 package name
      set_fact:
        jdk_package: >-
          {{ 'openjdk-21-jdk' if ansible_os_family == 'Debian'
             else ('openjdk-21-jdk' if ansible_distribution == 'Ubuntu'
                   else ('java-21-openjdk' if ansible_os_family in ['RedHat', 'Suse']
                         else 'java-21-openjdk')) }}

    - name: Update apt cache when using apt
      apt:
        update_cache: yes
        cache_valid_time: 3600
      when: ansible_pkg_mgr == 'apt'

  tasks:
    - name: Ensure OpenJDK 21 is installed
      package:
        name: "{{ jdk_package }}"
        state: present

    - name: Ensure application group exists
      group:
        name: "{{ app_group }}"
        system: true

    - name: Ensure application user exists
      user:
        name: "{{ app_user }}"
        group: "{{ app_group }}"
        system: true
        shell: "{{ nologin_shell_path }}"
        create_home: false

    - name: Create application base and config directories
      file:
        path: "{{ item.path }}"
        state: directory
        owner: "{{ item.owner | default(app_user) }}"
        group: "{{ item.group | default(app_group) }}"
        mode: "{{ item.mode | default('0750') }}"
      loop:
        - { path: "{{ app_base_dir }}" }
        - { path: "{{ config_dir }}", owner: "root", group: "{{ app_group }}", mode: "0750" }

    - name: Deploy application JAR
      copy:
        src: "{{ jar_src }}"
        dest: "{{ app_base_dir }}/{{ jar_name }}"
        owner: "{{ app_user }}"
        group: "{{ app_group }}"
        mode: "0640"
        backup: yes
      notify: Restart {{ service_name }}

    - name: Create environment file
      copy:
        dest: "{{ config_dir }}/{{ app_name }}.conf"
        owner: "root"
        group: "{{ app_group }}"
        mode: "0640"
        content: |
          JAVA_OPTS="{{ java_opts }}"
          APP_OPTS="{{ app_opts }}"
      notify: Restart {{ service_name }}

    - name: Create systemd unit file
      copy:
        dest: "/etc/systemd/system/{{ service_name }}.service"
        owner: "root"
        group: "root"
        mode: "0644"
        content: |
          [Unit]
          Description={{ app_name }} Java Service
          After=network-online.target
          Wants=network-online.target

          [Service]
          Type=simple
          User={{ app_user }}
          Group={{ app_group }}
          EnvironmentFile=-{{ config_dir }}/{{ app_name }}.conf
          WorkingDirectory={{ app_base_dir }}
          ExecStart=/usr/bin/java $JAVA_OPTS -jar {{ app_base_dir }}/{{ jar_name }} $APP_OPTS
          ExecStop=/bin/kill -s SIGTERM $MAINPID
          Restart=on-failure
          RestartSec=5s

          # Security hardening
          NoNewPrivileges=true
          PrivateTmp=true
          PrivateDevices=true
          ProtectSystem=strict
          ProtectHome=true
          ProtectClock=true
          ProtectKernelLogs=true
          ProtectKernelModules=true
          ProtectKernelTunables=true
          LockPersonality=true
          MemoryDenyWriteExecute=true
          RestrictRealtime=true
          RestrictSUIDSGID=true
          RemoveIPC=true
          SystemCallArchitectures=native
          RestrictNamespaces=true
          RestrictAddressFamilies=AF_UNIX AF_INET AF_INET6
          CapabilityBoundingSet=
          AmbientCapabilities=
          UMask=0077

          # Permit writes to required paths
          ReadWritePaths={{ app_base_dir }} {{ data_dir }} {{ log_dir }}

          # Managed directories (created by systemd and owned by service user)
          RuntimeDirectory={{ runtime_dir }}
          StateDirectory={{ app_name }}
          CacheDirectory={{ app_name }}
          LogsDirectory={{ app_name }}

          # Resource limits
          LimitNOFILE=65536
          TimeoutStopSec=30s

          [Install]
          WantedBy=multi-user.target
      notify:
        - Systemd daemon-reload
        - Restart {{ service_name }}

    - name: Ensure service is enabled and started
      systemd:
        name: "{{ service_name }}"
        enabled: true
        state: started
        daemon_reload: false

  handlers:
    - name: Systemd daemon-reload
      systemd:
        daemon_reload: true

    - name: Restart {{ service_name }}
      systemd:
        name: "{{ service_name }}"
        state: restarted
        enabled: true
